methodology_note: Structural Score excludes Evidence Traceability. Evidence is reported as a separate metric. Manual semantic review is still required.

cases.primary_target: Existing issue + action binding + unresolved release impact
manual_review: The 503 authentication/payment gateway failure is an existing issue.
QA stopping the checkout validation cycle is the supported impact.
4 PM applies to providing the status update, not necessarily completing the investigation.
Do not create a release-delay risk or schedule impact.
The release-date impact remains unresolved because it has not been reviewed yet.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: During checkout validation, the payment gateway returned 503 errors for all test transactions, leading QA to stop the checkout validation cycle. The Platform Team is investigating the gateway configuration and will provide a status update by 4 PM today. The release date has not been reviewed yet.

cases.primary_target: Existing issue + remediation action + no schedule impact
manual_review: Missing Mip Levels are the current issue.
The Art Tech Team commitment to regenerate and deliver the assets is an action.
The delivery deadline is tomorrow at noon.
Do not create a schedule impact because no milestone impact has been identified.
Do not invent a delivery-failure risk.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: Texture Streaming 테스트에서 세 개의 Asset에 필요한 Mip Level이 누락된 문제가 확인되어, Art Tech Team이 해당 Asset을 재생성하여 내일 정오까지 전달하기로 했습니다. 현재까지 Milestone 영향은 확인되지 않았습니다.

cases.primary_target: Completed activity without false findings
manual_review: This is a completed-success negative case.
The export and QA spot check both completed successfully.
Do not create an issue, risk, action, schedule impact, or uncertainty.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: The nightly data export completed successfully, and QA confirmed no errors in the exported records. No further action is required.

cases.primary_target: Current blocking issue + explicit recovery action
manual_review: The Read-Only Staging Database is an existing issue.
Integration testing being blocked is the directly supported impact.
The Database Team restoration / access confirmation is an explicit action.
11 AM applies to confirming access availability, not necessarily the restoration completion time.
Do not invent a release or milestone delay.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: Staging Database가 예기치 않게 Read-Only 상태로 전환되어 Integration 테스트 진행이 중단되었습니다. Database Team이 복구 중이며 오전 11시까지 접근 가능 여부를 확인할 예정입니다.

cases.primary_target: Proposed requirement + review action + approval uncertainty
manual_review: The 45-day retention value is proposed, not approved.
The Security Team Tuesday review is an explicit action.
No implementation effort estimate exists.
Do not invent a schedule impact or implementation risk.
Final approval remains uncertain.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: The data retention requirement is currently set to 14 days. A client has requested an increase to 45 days, but the change has not been approved. The Security Team is scheduled to review the proposal on Tuesday. No implementation effort estimate has been provided.

cases.primary_target: Confirmed requirement change + implementation action
manual_review: The retry-limit change from 5 to 3 is confirmed.
Applying the value from the next Sprint is an explicit Backend Team action.
No schedule impact should be generated.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: The login retry limit has been reduced from 5 to 3, and the change has been finalized. The Backend Team will implement the new value starting from the next Sprint. There are no additional schedule impacts due to this change.

cases.primary_target: Proposed setting change + approval dependency
manual_review: Telemetry remains disabled by default.
Enabling telemetry for Beta is proposed, not approved.
Client consent explicitly gates Legal approval.
The final decision remains unresolved.
Do not invent a schedule impact.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: Telemetry collection is currently disabled by default. The Product team proposed enabling it by default for the Beta release. Legal has stated that the change cannot be approved until client consent is received. No final decision has been made.

cases.primary_target: Conditional scope change + explicit additional effort
manual_review: High-Resolution Texture support is proposed, not approved.
Approximately two additional work days are explicitly supported if approved.
The additional effort supports an inferred risk / potential schedule impact.
No release milestone should be invented.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: 고객은 High-Resolution Texture 지원을 추가하는 변경안을 제안했습니다. Engineering은 변경 승인 시 약 이틀의 추가 작업이 필요하다고 설명했습니다. 변경안은 아직 승인되지 않았으며, Release Milestone은 논의되지 않았습니다.

cases.primary_target: Explicit dependency + nearby milestone timing risk
manual_review: The signed firmware package explicitly gates Certification testing.
The Wednesday package delivery followed by Thursday testing supports a future timing risk.
Do not invent a specific delay duration.
The Security Team package delivery is an explicit action.
The revised test schedule remains unresolved.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: Certification testing is scheduled for Thursday morning and depends on the availability of the signed firmware package, which is expected on Wednesday from the Security Team. No revised test schedule has been agreed upon.

cases.primary_target: Missing prerequisite + dependency + unknown ETA
manual_review: The missing Whitelist is an existing issue.
Whitelist activation explicitly gates Build Validation.
The unknown Whitelist completion time creates a supported risk to Friday Build Validation.
Do not invent a specific delay duration.
The unresolved item is the Whitelist completion timing.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: License Server Whitelist가 아직 활성화되지 않았으며, Build Validation 시작 전에 Whitelist가 활성화되어야 합니다. Build Validation은 금요일로 예정되어 있지만, Infrastructure Team이 Whitelist 적용 완료 일정을 제공하지 않았습니다.

cases.primary_target: Explicit dependency without invented timing risk
manual_review: Localization signoff explicitly gates store submission.
The Monday signoff is an explicit Localization Team action.
Do not create a risk solely because store submission is Wednesday.
No schedule concern has been reported.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: Localization signoff is a prerequisite for store submission, which is scheduled for Wednesday. The Localization Team will complete the signoff on Monday.

cases.primary_target: Multi-step dependency chain + missing owner
manual_review: Security Review completion gates Privacy Approval.
Privacy Approval gates Pilot Access activation.
Both dependencies are explicit.
The missing Security Review owner is the unresolved item.
Do not invent a schedule delay.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: The project requires a Security Review before obtaining Privacy Approval, and Privacy Approval is needed to activate Pilot Access. The Security Review owner is not yet assigned, and there are no current schedule changes.

cases.primary_target: Two owners + two deadlines + unresolved remediation date
manual_review: The intermittent connection drop is the existing issue.
Tuesday belongs to Support log collection.
Thursday belongs to Engineering log review.
Do not bind either date to remediation.
The remediation date remains uncertain.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: An intermittent connection drop is under investigation. Support will collect session logs by Tuesday, and Engineering will review them by Thursday. No remediation date has been committed.

cases.primary_target: Multiple independent actions with separate deadlines
manual_review: The intermittent Mobile Client crash is an existing issue.
The customer Device-list delivery and QA reproduction are separate actions.
Monday belongs to the customer Device-list action.
Wednesday belongs to QA crash reproduction.
The fix completion date remains unresolved.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: Mobile Client에서 간헐적인 Crash가 보고되었으며, 고객은 영향을 받은 Device 목록을 월요일까지 전달하기로 했습니다. QA는 수요일까지 Crash 재현을 완료할 예정입니다. 수정 완료 일정은 아직 정해지지 않았습니다.

cases.primary_target: Future commitment without hypothetical failure risk
manual_review: The Friday final-mix delivery is an explicit action.
The internal team can continue with the temporary mix.
Do not invent a risk that the vendor may miss Friday.
No schedule impact has been identified.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: The external audio vendor will deliver the final mix on Friday. The internal team can continue using the temporary mix until the final mix is delivered. No schedule impact has been identified.

cases.primary_target: Two future commitments + unresolved decision
manual_review: The Analytics Team cost estimate and Product Team review are two separate actions.
Tuesday belongs to the cost-estimate action.
Wednesday belongs to the Product Team review.
Whether the feature will actually be added remains unresolved.
Do not invent a requirement change approval or schedule impact.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: Analytics Team will share operational cost estimates for a new feature by Tuesday. The Product Team has scheduled a review of the proposal for Wednesday. However, whether the feature will be added is still undetermined.

cases.primary_target: Conflicting requirement information without approval

failures.evidence: The Product Manager said that 30 days may be preferable for the enterprise launch.

manual_review: Seven days remains the signed/current requirement.
Thirty days is only a proposed value.
The conflicting current and proposed values support an inferred consistency/readiness risk.
Do not invent a schedule impact.
The final retention requirement remains unresolved.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: The signed operations requirement specifies seven days of log retention. The Product Manager suggested increasing retention to 30 days for the enterprise launch, but the client has not approved the change. Operations continues to use the seven-day setting.

cases.primary_target: Conflicting schedule statements without final decision
manual_review: October 10 remains the official Launch Date.
October 12 is an Engineering Lead opinion, not an approved schedule change.
Do not select October 12 as the final schedule.
Do not create a confirmed schedule impact.
The unresolved item is the final schedule-change decision.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: The official launch date remains October 10th. While the Engineering Lead suggested October 12th as more realistic during a meeting, the Project Manager confirmed that the official schedule has not been changed. No final decision on the schedule change has been made.

cases.primary_target: Successful rollout with no findings
manual_review: The rollout completed successfully.
Monitoring remained normal and no incidents were reported.
No follow-up work is required.
Do not create any findings.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: The feature rollout was completed successfully across all target regions. Monitoring remained within normal ranges for 24 hours, and no incidents were reported.

cases.primary_target: Clean status update without fabricated findings
manual_review: This is a clean status-update negative case.
No scope change, blocker, risk, or action exists.
Do not create findings or uncertainties.

structural_checks.name: summary_present
structural_checks.actual: The customer has confirmed there are no changes to the Scope. The Development Team is proceeding with the existing plan and has not reported any Blockers or new Risks. No additional Action Items have been identified.
